findings.finding: PersistentAfxCore emits audit events, but the repository on main has no persistent audit implementation and the constructor defaults to a no-op audit.
findings.required_action: Make persistent security audit repository-backed with schema, append, retention purge, tests and evidence.

findings.finding: Main Gateway uses an in-memory counter map through synchronous process(); persistent distributed rate limiting is not integrated on main.
findings.required_action: Integrate persistent/distributed limiter and prove multi-instance behavior.

findings.finding: No end-to-end protected domain request contract currently demonstrates tenant plus permission/resource-policy enforcement.
findings.required_action: Add protected request contract with 401/403/allow evidence while keeping business authorization outside Gateway.

findings.finding: Experience correctly rejects local /api/*, but real Experience -> canonical API auth-context 200/401/403 runtime evidence is not established.
findings.required_action: Add controlled integration evidence without creating local auth authority.

findings.finding: The main branch package does not currently expose the hardened audit/concurrency test evidence expected by the repair contract.
findings.required_action: Restore/add persistent audit and refresh concurrency tests and require them in CI.

findings.finding: Known implementation uses scrypt while the production policy calls for calibrated Argon2id/equivalent review.
findings.required_action: Complete approved calibration/security review or migrate and record evidence.

findings.finding: The Agent workflow requires a self-hosted afaghx-ai runner and no successful runtime proof has established the full Golden Execution chain.
findings.required_action: Execute on a connected runner with Ollama/OpenCode and retain evidence before PROVEN.

gate.rule: No GREEN/PROVEN while critical/high findings remain open or runtime evidence is absent.
gate.next: Repair findings on isolated branches, execute tests, collect evidence, then re-audit.
